caption_L1: Growth of advertising spending in the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) from 2010 to 2022 , by medium is a bar plot. The y-axis shows Year using categorical scale starting at 2010 and ending at 2022* while the x-axis shows Magazines using categorical scale starting with −0.4 and ending with 0.8.
caption_L2L3: There is no obvious pattern and the spend grows and shrinks in different years.  There is huge growth in 2017.  However, there is a decrease in the two years prior, in 2015 and 2016.  Out of the 13 years there has been growth in seven and shrinkage in six.  2016 saw the biggest shrinkage in sales.  In the past five years there have been four years of shrinkage and one of growth.
